title: Sandbagging Detection via Performance Inconsistency Probes

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If capability evaluations are systematically gamed via sandbagging, the entire evaluations-and-benchmarks pipeline for AI control loses validity. A detection probe directly addresses this existential threat to the evaluation paradigm.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Designing paired evaluation prompts (with and without eval framing) and measuring performance deltas is conceptually straightforward. Uses API calls, no fine-tuning. Beginners can implement this with basic Python.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single experiment with a clear independent variable (eval framing) and dependent variable (performance delta). Deliverable is a performance-delta table across models. Achievable in 30 hours with 3-5 models and one capability domain.
